span.p: 1 · REQUEST AND ACCOUNTABILITY

Task trigger
manual · Git/CI · webhook · cron

Authenticated human
solo: one developer holds all roles
team/regulated: separation by policy

Human-only decisions
QA · Product Owner · disclosure · Operations
2 · OPENCLAW ORCHESTRATION

Workflow-controller plugin
prepare · track · stop safely

Durable orchestration
Managed Task Flow + Lobster
save progress · limit retries · resume safely

Workflow checkpoint
wait for the required human role
3 · BOUNDED EXECUTION AND REVIEW

Local execution lanes
Development · independent QA · Maintenance
Ollama · isolated worktree · bounded packet

Policy-selected review path
local-only OR sanitized Kimi/Codex review

Authenticated MCP actions
controller scope · human role scope · evidence only

4A · GIT POLICY BUNDLE
permissions · deny tests

4B · CERBOS DECISION
ALLOW / DENY
contextual policy · call ID

4C · GO MCP GATEWAY
check identity · load context · authorize · validate

Clear responsibilities
OpenClaw: chooses the next step
Cerbos: decides who may act
Go: allows valid state changes
PostgreSQL: saves the official record

Immutable artifacts
patches · manifests · checks · reviews

PostgreSQL authority
roles · tasks · code graph · official record
evidence · versions · approvals · outbox

Milvus semantic discovery
approved items only
queried through MCP · stable PostgreSQL IDs

Local Ollama
embedding

5 · APPROVED LEARNING
Idempotent outbox worker
